parts.title: A Gray Morning
parts.text: The morning was **dreary**. Gray clouds hid the sun, and a **drizzle** tapped on the window. Kenji, Maria, and Eli wanted to play outside. They pressed their noses to the glass and sighed. Then a **rumble** of thunder shook the house.

parts.title: Into the Rain
parts.text: Soon the rain became a **downpour**. “Put on your **raincoat**,” said Mom. The wind was **blustery**, and it pulled at their hoods. They heard water **drip** from the roof as they ran to the park.

parts.title: Puddle Fun
parts.text: Eli stomped into a **murky** puddle. Mud began to **splatter** on his boots. A big splash was about to **drench** Maria. “I am **soaked**!” she laughed. Then little balls of ice, called **hail**, bounced on the path, and the children ran home.

parts.title: Warm Again
parts.text: Back inside, Maria hung her scarf by the door. They sat by the window with warm cocoa. The rain was still falling, but nobody minded. It had turned a gray day into a fun one.
